verdicts.notes: Repairs met. B1a: no drawn outline; the edge is a lighter-to-darker yellow carried by value against the ground (edge ring has no dark pixels). B3/C2: the same pale-yellow segmented glossy grub as the kept south/north (soft gloss, white speculars, paler round spots along the flank, small stubby legs, small black eye and curved mandibles), same height on the canvas (0.31 vs 0.31/0.30). C1: head and mandibles at the right, so it faces east; west mirrors it. Legs present (four stubby legs under the body). D4: real alpha, no backdrop, halo or ground shadow. B2: at 32 px/cell it reads as a bright yellow shape clearly apart from the brown ground. Polish (no ticket): side-on the body looks a little bulkier than the compact south/north suggest; height agrees, so no C2 fault.
